blocks.html: On May 26, Thursday, Robinsons Place Gen. Trias, in Cavite will be hold its Grand Opening with Kapamilya Stars leading the star-studded event. Maja Salvador, Robinsons Malls’ Celebrity Endorser together with her erstwhile leading man JC de Vera , Star Music recording artist Markki Stroem and 20015 Mutya ng Pilipinas Leren Mae Bautista will kick off a special show to be held at the Mall’s Atrium Area at 11:00 am. The following day, May 27 Robinsons Department Store’s Celebrity Endorser Erich Gonzales will have a Meet and Greet session at 3pm while on May 28 Elmo Magalona will be at the Mall’s Activity Area at 3pm. Jolina Magdangal, Michael Pangilinan, Kaye Cal and Ylona Garica will be performing on May 29 at 5 pm as part of the Himig Album Tour. Enchong Dee will be at Robinsons Place Gen. Trias on June 5 at 5pm for an exciting Album and tour a CD Signing. Follow these exciting events and use the #RobinsonsPlaceGenTrias and #RobinsonsPlaceGenTriasNowOpen.
